title: Cheat Sheet
paragraphs: “It’s a fitting punishment for someone who would call Imia-chan distasteful just by looking at her.”
“That’s terrible, nano!”
“Yeah… Imia-chan’s face isn’t bad at all. I think she’s actually cute.”
My rival and assistant nodded at Father’s words, while the mole seemed to be fidgeting shyly. I don’t really understand the mole’s standards.
“Is that so? We don’t really get it.”
“Windia-san was raised among monsters, so her sense of beauty might be different.”
“Itsuki? Are you really saying that too?”
“Hiie! N-no, that’s not what I meant. I’m just saying that neither we nor Windia-san really understand the original standard.”
“You don’t understand?”
The assistant tilted their head. I really don’t get it either.
“Sakura doesn’t understand.”
“K-Kou doesn’t either!”
“Yuki doesn’t understand either, desu wa.”
“I don’t understand either.”

“You know… oh, whatever. Anyway, there’s no need to feel sympathy for those guys who injured Sakura-chan, kept making excuses, and even called Imia-chan distasteful just from looking at her. And besides, if things go as the previous version of me suggested to Motoyasu-kun, we won’t even have to deal with them directly—they’ll end up rampaging on their own, and we’ll have to step in eventually anyway.”

Father chuckled darkly until the King of Faubrey began his official duties. It was quite terrifying. Not long after that, a group of soldiers arrived to greet us. They led us inside the castle and guided us to the audience chamber. In the first world, Father had a rather memorable conversation with the Queen about Takt. For now, it seemed that the pig king was still alive. Well, even if Takt showed up, we were strong enough to utterly defeat him, so there was nothing to worry about. Thinking that, we continued walking until we were led into the throne room.
“Bufufufufu… Welcome, Four Holy Heroes. I am the King of Faubrey.”
After a mysterious fanfare played by the soldiers, a creature that could only be described as a pig appeared and spoke. No matter how many times I see him, he always looks like a giant, bloated pig.
No… he’s worse than a pig.

Would it be more accurate to describe him as some kind of monster, a fusion of a frog, a snake, and a pig? If someone called him a new type of chimera, it wouldn’t feel out of place. The character he most resembles… now that I think about it, back when I was in Japan, there was a pig in my university’s film research club who was watching an old sci-fi movie, and I vaguely remember an enemy character that looked just like this one. Ren and Itsuki both looked puzzled at the sight of the king. Father maintained a perfectly neutral expression, as if it were plastered onto his face. Then, he leaned in and whispered to me.
“Is that thing a human? A beastman? Or is it actually a monster that crawled out from the Waves?”
“I have no idea. But I’ve heard that those chosen as heroes throughout history either marry into or become part of the royal lineage, ensuring their bloodline is incorporated.”
“So that means the Faubrey royal family is a condensed lineage of past Four Holy Heroes and Seven Star Heroes?”
“That thing is? It doesn’t look like a hero in the slightest.”
“Wait, think about us as a reference…”

We were huddled together, whispering in secret. Back in the first world, Father used to do this kind of thing with Ane-san and Filo-tan. I was always a bit jealous of that, so this actually felt kind of fun.
“Motoyasu might be an exception since he’s good-looking, but otherwise, we’re all just a bunch of gaming nerds.”
“That’s true, but the way you put it is unpleasant…”

“Wouldn’t it make sense that guys like that, suddenly transported to another world, would end up fulfilling their dream of being heroes, surrounding themselves with cute princesses, and forming harems?”
“It’s not entirely out of the question, is it? If you think about the children they’d have and their descendants… it might eventually lead to, well, something like that…”
“A genetic imprint of the gamer’s soul?”
“In novels about isekai summoning, the protagonists tend to accomplish all sorts of things, but when you listen to Motoyasu-kun’s stories, they don’t exactly sound like saints, do they?”
“Now that you put it that way… If their descendants are anything like them, heroes don’t exactly seem like the most upstanding individuals.”
“You do realize we’re talking about ourselves here, right…?”
This was a rabbit hole we really shouldn’t go down. Still, something jogged my memory—I’d heard about the traits of Faubrey’s royal bloodline somewhere before.

“Apparently, the descendants of heroes are extremely picky about appearances, love to fool around, build harems, outmaneuver others, and are obsessed with winning. Many of them are also shut-ins. I’ve also heard that a lot of them turn out to be good-looking men and women.”
“Would the number of attractive people depend on their local partners?”
“Wouldn’t there be a high proportion of open-minded, chubby otaku genes mixed in?”
“So that’s what it means to be a hero…”

Even Father, Ren, and Itsuki sighed in unison. A world saved by overweight otaku doesn’t make for a great picture. Though, I suppose you can’t completely dismiss the idea. Well, at the very least, it’s undeniable that the King of Faubrey is a pig drowning in his own lust.
“Yeah, let’s just chalk it up to atavism and leave it at that.”
With that, we all nodded to each other before moving on to introductions. Ren went first.
“I am Amaki Ren, summoned as the Sword Hero.”
The pig king of Faubrey rolled his eyes and leered at Ren, making his skin crawl. His inhuman nature remained unchanged.
“A man, huh? I prefer them a bit younger.”
“Ugh…”
Ren had a rather feminine face. That must have been why he nearly caught the eye of the King of Faubrey. But this pig king… he seems to be into men as well.
I bet he doesn’t even care as long as there’s a hole, huh?
Just like how I used to be! Ren instinctively crossed his arms to shield himself and took a few steps back.
Now, it’s my turn!
“I am Kitamura Motoyasu! The Love Hunter!”
“You completely forgot to introduce what kind of Hero you are, and on top of that, you just went and called yourself the Love Hunter!?”
“He’s the Spear Hero. He’s also a bit… loose in the head, so please don’t mind him.”

Father quipped, and Itsuki provided a more reasonable explanation. Meanwhile, the pig king wasn’t even looking at me. Instead, he was licking his lips while staring at Yuki and the others. On the other hand, Yuki and Sakura were also licking their lips. They must have mistaken him for some kind of delicious monster. Kou, however, looked slightly terrified. He probably thought he looked tasty but figured eating him would get him in trouble.
“Hey, Naofumi, he looks greasy and delicious.”
“Shh…!”
“Nano!”
Even my rival was drooling just as much as Sakura.
In any case, there’s no way I’m letting the pig king have Yuki and the others!
“Next is me. I am Kawasumi Itsuki, summoned as the Bow Hero.”
The pig king shot a sharp glare at Itsuki. His reaction was noticeably different compared to when he looked at Ren or me.
“Hmm… not bad.”
“What do you mean by that!?”
Itsuki responded, clearly far more terrified than Ren had been. Ren and Itsuki, as if sensing imminent danger, instinctively grabbed each other’s hands.
“Uh… I am Iwatani Naofumi, summoned as the Shield Hero. These are our companions.”
At Father’s introduction, everyone gave a polite bow.
“Buhuhuhu… You’ve done well to withstand Melromarc’s schemes and make it here, Heroes of the Four Saints. Ahem… As you likely already know, this world is heading toward destruction due to the Waves.”
The pig king had his subordinate open up a cheat sheet and proceeded to read from it.
Isn’t it you who doesn’t actually understand anything here? This guy is even less reliable than Melromarc.
“I assume you’ve already been briefed on the situation by Melromarc, but I’d like to confirm. How do you Heroes perceive the current crisis?”
“Well… The phenomenon known as the Waves releases monsters that attack people. Our job is to respond to that, right? We’ve seen it firsthand, and all four of us have fought in it.”
“Yeah, and since there are Dragon Hourglasses all over the world, we need to handle each Wave accordingly.”
“It seems like an endless battle, but in the meantime, we just have to keep strengthening ourselves and facing the Waves head-on, correct?”
Starting with Father, Ren and Itsuki took turns explaining the details of the Waves.
“…And yet, despite that, Melromarc prioritized its own religious beliefs over the crisis and even tried to frame the Shield Hero.”
“We overcame their schemes and have now arrived in the world’s greatest nation, Faubrey. We wish to use the power of the Heroes for the sake of the world.”

“Buhuhuhu… It seems you Heroes’ understanding of the situation is largely correct. Yes, Faubrey, along with the other nations, entrusts the task of handling the Waves to you. We pray for you to suppress the Calamity of Destruction.”
Well, at least he somewhat understands the situation.
But seriously, why does he need a cheat sheet for this?
